name: com.e7.protobuf-unity
author: Sirawat Pitaksarit/5argon - Exceed7 Experiments
description: Automatic .proto files compilation in Unity project to C# as you edit them, plus other Protobuf utilities related to Unity.

samples.description: A multi-file .proto graph across folders: imports, a shared package, well-known types, maps, oneof, enums, and more. Dependency-free (uses only the bundled Google.Protobuf).
A gRPC service definition (unary + server streaming) plus setup notes. Requires a gRPC runtime (grpc-dotnet + YetAnotherHttpHandler, or MagicOnion); not needed for plain serialization.
Two folders that compile with different C# output options via a per-folder ProtobufCsharpOptions asset: one generates internal classes, the other public.
